name: Winter Solstice Pack
description:
It's Solstice Time.



Owning this Winter Solstice Pack brings you the following four stylish Hunnys Closet Items, just in time for Winter Solstice festivals:

Hat: Winter Solstice Crown

Accessory: Winter Solstice Dangle Earring



Hair Style: Winter Solstice Curls



Face Sticker: Winter Solstice Eyeshadow



All pieces purchased within this Hunnys Closet Shop collection will immediately unlock the specified item(s) for use in the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io).



As long as you currently hold this token in the same wallet that you are connected with when using the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io), it will automatically be available for use - enjoy!
